Climate only: the real-species plant lists were removed, because this game uses its own invented plant families (docs/DESIGN.md §C). climate.temp_c is mean annual °C; moisture is 0 (bone dry) to 1 (waterlogged); altitude_m where given.
name: Alpine meadow
notes: Subalpine-alpine herb meadows and grasslands just above treeline: Alps/Pyrenees mat-grass and fescue meadows, Rocky Mountain wildflower meadows, Tibetan/Himalayan Kobresia meadows. Grasses and sedges dominate with showy forbs.
